name: Cryonic-Corrie
description: From orbit the planet is a painted oval, serene; up close it is violence given volume. Hurricane cells wider than moons chase each other along the shear lines, and the lightning never quite stops.

In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Herds of six-limbed graziers shadow the meltwater margins, wary of anything that walks upright.

The terrain around starship crash site (warship) is scarred for kilometers, and the wreck's black box still loops two seconds of static on an obsolete band. Insurance investigators consider it a haunted assignment.
For traders, antimatter traces alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
